title: How Istanbul Ended Up on Two Continents
desc: Istanbul spans Europe and Asia across the Bosphorus. Greek settlers from Megara first founded Chalcedon on the Asian shore; according to Strabo, an oracle later told the founders of Byzantium to build "opposite the blind", which they took to mean Chalcedon, and they settled the far better European site. Watch the full story on YouTube: Map Behind History. #istanbul #bosphorus #history #geography #maps
